input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced
input.rationale: There are no audit, inspection or verification rights running against us — the records flow the other way (Contractor must supply supporting detail with invoices), and there is no Contractor right of access to our systems. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Contractor shall be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: On termination we pay only fees and expenses actually incurred or earned; there are no liquidated damages, penalties, minimum termination fees or late-payment interest payable by us. Section 5 in fact allows us to withhold fees on an anti-bribery termination, which is in our favour.
